description: Propose and score chart variants for a selected Semiotic component. Uses the capability registry plus heuristic variant discovery: registered variants, conservative transforms, and same-intent cross-family alternatives. Returns ranked proposals with fit/novelty/risk scores, rationale, and ready-to-use props. Use after suggestCharts when an agent wants to actively explore variants rather than stop at the first chart recommendation.

audience.description: Audience profile — familiarity, adoption targets, exposure level, and reception modality.

component.description: Base chart component to vary, e.g. 'LineChart', 'BarChart', or 'BoxPlot'.

data.description: Row data to profile. Overrides props.data when present.

fieldRoles.description: Per-field semantic or exact encoding-role hints used before chart ranking.

identifiers.description: Fields that identify records and must not be used as visual encodings or measures.

intent.description: Ranking intent(s), e.g. trend, distribution, rank, compare-categories, composition-over-time.

props.description: Existing chart props. If props.data is present it is profiled; network/hierarchy/geo object data can be passed here as raw input.

name: proposeChartVariants
